sections.title: New
items: Stop keeping a copy of the bundle in your workspace

sections.title: Fixes
items: Clean up files only early test builds shipped
Keep adversarial skills out of routing bullets
Scan only git-visible files for removed skill names

sections.title: Other
items: Drop leftovers of the workspace copy

sections.title: New
items: adversarial-review: a fresh read-only critic finds and verifies issues and reports them without fixing anything; plan mode and a separate list for issues that were already there
adversarial-test: an adversary writes failing tests that are then frozen, and the implementer may change only production code

adversarial-implementation v2: the critic is chosen by capability, every finding carries a proof the lead runs, at most three rounds with frozen tests and a final round that may only delete; a start line shows who plays each role and how to change it
Start the adversarial skills in plain words or with their slash command (#69, #71, #72)
OpenCode: a critic model row, so the adversarial skills' critic (inspector) can run a stronger model than the other subagents

sections.title: Fixes
items: Critics can no longer reach MCP tools such as Playwright, whether they run in OpenCode, Codex or Claude Code

Riggverk replaces Agent Workspace. Quit Agent Workspace, move Agent Workspace.app to the Trash and install Riggverk.app (see Install). Your settings and backups move to Riggverk's folder on the first launch.

sections.title: New
items: Copilot, Pi and Kilo as opt-in harnesses: rules block, skills and the Playwright MCP entry (#40, #41, #42)
One shared SKILL.md per skill, installed into each folder your harnesses read; see which copy each harness loads (#28, #30, #33, #34)
Resolve a conflicting skill or agent file: keep your version or take the bundled one (#44, #45)
Library: bundled items are read-only and come straight from the app; edit your personal docs and your own refinements below the rules base (#49, #52, #57)

OpenCode: version-aware health with CLI probes and lsp, model/small model/subagent model overrides, runtime rows that show what differs, warnings when other config files or env override the team settings, only the bundled tui.json keys are managed, XDG_CONFIG_HOME is followed (#31, #32, #54, #55, #60, #63)
What's new after each update
New skills: adversarial-implementation, security-audit, kretsverket-status-report (#19, #20, #21)
Master-detail pages, bracket buttons, apply progress and motion levels (#14, #17)

sections.title: Changed
items: Renamed to Riggverk; app data moves on first launch (#37, #39)
Prompt Builder, Brain Setup and the in-app release check are removed (#26, #27)
The workspace folder chooser is gone: a saved folder keeps working, and `R` resets to the default after a confirm
Playwright MCP 0.0.83 runs your installed Google Chrome; tools that web pages register (WebMCP) are off

sections.title: Fixes
items: OpenCode permissions match OpenCode 1.19.3: compound commands are checked part by part, and secret files are denied in bash however the path is written (#29, #65, #66)
The managed OpenCode config converges, and health compares with what Install writes (#51, #56)
The window opens centered at 1280x800, the boot lines clear the traffic lights, and the pane grid holds at large text (#13, #22, #38)
Codex delegation only when Codex is installed and logged in
The Playwright entry is added to an existing mcp.json
